div.head: II Cn 15.1a
div.ab: And on Dena lage lahslites scyldig, butan he geladige, þæt he na bet ne cuðe.
⁊ on Dena laga lahslites scyldig, buton he hine geladige, þæt he na bet ne cuðe.
In Denalaga láhslichtes reus sit, nisi se allegiet (si non iuret), quod melius nesciuit.
⁊ on Dena laga lahslites scyldig, buton he híne geladige, þæt he na bet ne cuðe.
And on Dena lage lahslites scyldig, butan he geladige þæt he na bet ne cuðe.
Und im Dänen-Rechtsgebiete [sei jener Richter] Rechtsbruchbusse schuldig, ausser wenn er (sich BA) ausweist, dass er [es] nicht besser wusste.
And in the Danelaw [let that judge] be liable for lahslit, unless he clears (himself, B A) [by showing] that he did not know better.
And in the Danelaw he shall forfeit lahslit, unless he clear himself, asserting that he did not know any better verdict.
And in the Danelaw he is to forfeit lahslit, unless he clear himself—that he knew no better.
In the Danelaw, he shall be liable for his lahslit, unless he can exonerate himself by proving that he did not know any better.
div.note: see p. 446, n. 6. The lahslit for a king’s thegn was 10 half-marks, rather higher than 120 West Saxon shillings.
he geladige: he hine geladige AB
